Name: Pet Water Bowl
Author: Mizzion
Description:
Have you ever wondered why the game didn't water the pet bowl on days that it rained, snowed or stormed? Well wonder no longer. This mod will do just that.

Once you run the game for the first time you install this mod, a config file will be created that allows you to change the following:

EnableMod -> Tells SMAPI if it should run the mod or not.

EnableSnowWatering -> Whether the game should water the pet bowl when its snowing. (Snow is a form of water isn't it? :P)

EnableSprinklerWatering -> Whether the game should water the pet bowl if it finds an [b]Iridium Sprinkler[/b] around it.




[size=4]How to Install the Mod:[/size]
[list=1]
[*]Install the latest version of SMAPI (Currently 2.10.1): https://smapi.io
[*]Unzip the PetWaterBowl folder from the ZIP file you downloaded here.
[*]Put the PetWaterBowl folder inside your "Stardew Valley/Mods" folder.
[*]Run the game. It should be working now.
[/list]

[size=6]With SDV 1.4 your pet bowl will be watered when it's raining.[/size]

Downloads.Description: Updated to work with SDV 1.6 and added watering from sprinklers
